results.title: Delhi Police may take action on abusive content made against PM Modi during CJP protest
results.description: Delhi Police is contemplating action against "objectionable" and "abusive" social media posts targeting Prime Minister Narendra Modi and other leaders during the Jantar Mantar CJP protest, a source said.

results.title: Verstappen double downs on ‘undriveable’ Red Bull despite second place finish at Hungary
results.description: Verstappen had earlier described the car as “undriveable” a comment repeated by team-mate Isack Hadjar who finished sixth.
